tools.name: beebole_current_person
tools.description: Return the person that the API key belongs to: id, name and email. Call it first to learn the person id that the other tools need. GraphQL: currentPerson.

tools.name: beebole_list_people
tools.description: List the people in the account with their id, name and archived flag. GraphQL: getPersons.

tools.name: beebole_list_projects
tools.description: List projects with their id and name. Filter by project category id or archived flag. Use the ids in beebole_log_time. GraphQL: getProjects.

tools.name: beebole_list_tasks
tools.description: List tasks with their id, name, start and end times, and status. Filter by planning (task category) id or archived flag. Use the ids in beebole_log_time. GraphQL: getTasks.

tools.name: beebole_list_tags
tools.description: List tags (groups of people, projects and tasks) with their id, name and level. GraphQL: getTags.

tools.name: beebole_list_time_records
tools.description: List logged time records (not time off) that start between two dates, inclusive, in UTC. The window can be up to 366 days. Each record has its id, duration in milliseconds, start time, person and projects. GraphQL: getTimeRecords.

tools.name: beebole_log_time
tools.description: Create one time record for a person: start time (ISO 8601), duration in minutes, and optional task, projects, comment and non-billable flag. Creates data in the account. GraphQL: addTimeRecord.

tools.name: beebole_update_time_record_duration
tools.description: Set a new duration, in minutes, on an existing time record. Overwrites the logged duration. GraphQL: editTimeRecordDuration.

tools.name: beebole_update_time_record_comment
tools.description: Replace the comment on an existing time record. GraphQL: editTimeRecordComment.
